title: On-Demand JSON: A Better Way to Parse Documents?
relevance: The paper introducing simdjson's On-Demand API. Describes the lazy parsing architecture where the parser iterates through content only materializing results on access. The baseline this concept aims to improve.

title: Mison: A Fast JSON Parser for Data Analytics
relevance: Pioneered speculative field location prediction and structural indices for JSON. The two-level approach (speculate location, then verify) is conceptually similar to lazy materialization with deferred verification.

title: JSONSki: streaming semi-structured data with bit-parallel fast-forwarding
relevance: Bit-parallel fast-forwarding enables skipping irrelevant JSON regions during streaming. The skip mechanism is a key component of the lazy pointer machine's skip_value() operation.
